item.title: US and Iran at impasse as 60-day negotiation window closes
item.description: The 60-day deadline for the US and Iran to reach a broader peace agreement and reopen the Strait of Hormuz expires Monday, with no deal reached.

item.title: UK prime minister corresponds with impersonator of senior Trump aide
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham exchanged messages with an individual posing as White House chief of staff Susie Wiles.

item.title: Actress Hayden Panettiere remembered as 'amazing talent' after death at 36
item.description: Panettiere, known for "Heroes" and "Nashville," passed away at 36, her representative confirmed to ABC News.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere, star of "Heroes" and "Remember the Titans," dies at 36
item.description: Hayden Panettiere, who appeared in "Remember the Titans" as a child and gained fame in the sci-fi series "Heroes," has died at age 36.
